descriptions.tn: True Negative: Genuine message correctly identified as ham
descriptions.tp: True Positive: Spam message correctly identified as spam
descriptions.fp: False Positive (Type I Error): Genuine message falsely flagged as spam

evaluation.imbalance_insight: Because Ham constitutes 87.34% of the test set, a trivial dummy baseline predicting all Ham achieves 87.34% accuracy with 0% Spam recall. The model's 95.12% Precision and 89.31% Recall confirm genuine probabilistic token discrimination.
